card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of a longer word that is still unfinished, such as place names, personal names, drug names and capitalized warning words. The next piece is needed to complete the word.

card.writes: It pushes toward continuing the word with more word pieces and away from punctuation or spaces that would end a word.
card.plain: It fires when a long word or name is only half spelled out and must continue.
